//: The root tsconfig's `include` covers packages/* only, and extending it there would edit a file pi owns — the one thing this branch does not do. So bluclawd typechecks itself: `npx tsgo -p bluclawd`. `src`, `docs` and `examples` are symlinks back into packages/coding-agent (see README) and are excluded so the program does not pull pi's whole source in twice under a second path.
